planner_baseline_protocol_inspection.interpretation: Protocol inspection only; literal plans can reflect math knowledge despite planner-schema failure.

raw_answer_posthoc_diagnostic.answer_metric: LLM emits numeric answer itself; exact Fraction comparison only scores it.
raw_answer_posthoc_diagnostic.interpretation: Planner-format learning does not prove an improvement in raw arithmetic or arbitrary reasoning.
limits: Protocol created after planner validation was observed; posthoc development diagnostic, not untouched gold.
Finite synthetic validation phrases, not national curriculum or real-school certification.
Malformed/schema/plan outputs are protocol failures; low score alone does not prove lack of mathematical knowledge.
Answer-only evaluation does not certify explanation quality or OCR.
One comma/dot is explicitly a decimal mark; grouped thousands and ambiguous mixed notation are rejected.
No weights updated and no deployment or acceptance decision is changed.

step_guidance: separate verified step renderer and student one-hint policy; not free-prose model certification
architecture: grounded expression planner + independent supported-template validator + exact Fraction calculator
training_objective: short observable arithmetic plan, no long hidden thought supervision
data: 2000 synthetic train + 176 independently screened public train; 160 val and 160 synthetic heldout test
limitations: Finite synthetic wording families; no coverage guarantee for arbitrary Vietnamese problems.
Math accuracy evaluates LLM plan with an exact calculator, not raw numeric LLM arithmetic.
Public train additions are source-imported with independent arithmetic checks, not semantic or teacher certification.
Heldout test is synthetic development data, not a secret independent school benchmark.
No OCR-to-solution pipeline or student-facing deployment is certified.

runtime_development.semantic_contract: published raw full-match templates only; not arbitrary Vietnamese/OCR
runtime_development.model_plan_vs_calculator: model must select valid grounded plan; exact calculator produces final answer
